tiers.name: 2.5% on a single purchase that bills and posts at $5,000 or more

special.text: 2.5% is per SWIPE: each purchase must bill+post >= $5,000. One ~$3,800 bar = 2%; ring 2+ bars in one swipe = 2.5%.
Business card (sole prop with SSN ok). Chase 5/24 and Ink velocity rules apply; needs Chase business approval.
Pay-in-full charge card: whole balance due every statement (small Flex for Business slice can revolve at 17.74%+ APR).
Cash back only: points cannot move to Sapphire/other Ink cards, so no transfer-partner upside. 1 point = 1 cent.
Exclusions list cash-like, betting, checks; bullion is NOT named. Chase does shut down MS-pattern accounts (TPG shutdown pattern).
No foreign transaction fee; no published cap on 2% or 2.5%; spending power is dynamic (no fixed limit), unverified for $50k/mo.
Bill pay = bank account (ACH) only; debit card not accepted online/phone. Taekus debit stack does not work here.

tiers.name: 2.5%: Smartly Savings ($25) + $10,000-$49,999 30-day avg in Smartly Checking/Safe Debit

special.text: Smartly Earning Bonus (the part above 2%) applies to only the first $10,000 net purchases per billing cycle; rest earns 2%.
Post-4/14/25 rules: ONLY Bank Smartly Checking + Safe Debit balances count (30-day avg); savings, brokerage, IRA no longer qualify.
$100k must sit in ~0% checking: ~$330/mo lost interest at 4% APY = 3.3% of a $10k month, 0.66% of a $50k month.
Bonus exclusions: education, gift cards, insurance, tax, B2B, third-party bill pay. Costco MCC 5300 earns bonus (Rinad 6584 stmt shows 4% w/ $10k cap).
Redeem into a U.S. Bank deposit account for full 1 cent/pt; statement credit / gift card redemptions pay less.
U.S. Bank shuts down MS-pattern accounts fast (FlyerTalk shutdown thread); 3% foreign fee; no debit-card bill pay.
Cards opened before 4/14/25 were grandfathered (no cap, $5k tier, savings count); confirm on your own statement.

tiers.name: Successor Bilt Blue (Column N.A.): 1x points + 4% Bilt Cash on everyday spend, $0 fee
Successor Bilt Obsidian: 1x other (3x dining/grocery) + 4% Bilt Cash, $95 fee
Successor Bilt Palladium: 2x on all other purchases + 4% Bilt Cash, $495 fee

special.text: DEAD: Wells Fargo stopped apps 11/5/25; cards went inactive 2/7/26 and auto-converted to WF Autograph Visa unless opted into Bilt 2.0.
Successor Bilt Card 2.0 (Blue $0 / Obsidian $95 / Palladium $495) issued by Column N.A., serviced by Cardless, Mastercard, no FX fee.
2.0 has NO warehouse-club exclusion and NO 5-transaction rule: Costco earns 1x (Blue/Obsidian) or 2x (Palladium) Bilt Points.
rate_pct assumes 2.0 cents/pt via transfer partners (Hyatt etc). Cash-out is far lower; 1x at Costco is only ~1% if you cash out.
4% Bilt Cash is NOT cash: no statement credit, no cash-out, expires 12/31 (only $100 rolls). Uses: $30 per $1k rent, $10 Lyft, $10 Walgreens/mo.
Terms let Bilt deny/recover points AND Bilt Cash on 'manufactured spend' or spend 'inconsistent with normal consumer use'.
Bill pay via linked bank account through the Bilt app; no debit-card bill-pay channel found (unverified).
